bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -tAqc "SELECT 'LEGACY_RECRUITMENT_BUTTONS='||count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id WHERE a.kind='recruitment' AND d.status='sent' AND d.inline_buttons::text LIKE '%?start=a_%'; SELECT 'PUBLISHED_RECRUITMENTS='||count(*) FROM announcement_posts WHERE kind='recruitment' AND status='published'; SELECT 'LEGACY_ROOM_LINK_BUTTONS='||count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id WHERE a.kind='recruitment' AND a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND d.status='sent' AND d.inline_buttons::text LIKE '%?start=a_%'"
